card.name: Space before section numbers in cross-references
card.fires_on: The space right after an opening parenthesis in a label cross-reference such as "[see Drug Interactions (", just before the section number. Also fires on a space before a numbered study or section heading.

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: The space after the opening parenthesis of a "[see Section Name (" reference, before the section number.

modes.label: Before a numbered item
modes.description: A space just before a study number or the next numbered section heading.

card.writes: It seems to add little beyond a slight push toward line breaks and ellipses, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a section number comes next in a "see Section X" reference in a drug label.
